'''Lenan Organa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] who was a [[General/Legends|general]] of [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] army during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When the [[Alderaan Civil War]] broke out between various royal noble houses she was put in charge of the war camp tasked with protection of [[Panteer Refuge]], where [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Katei Elinari Panteer]] - the closest to an heir to the [[Silara Panteer|assassinated queen]] - were hiding. The general also led the forces fighting against [[House Ulgo]] soldiers deployed at the ruins of the [[Castle Panteer]] which was occupied by the self-proclaimed [[King/Legends|King]] [[Bouris Ulgo]].
